name: product-tile
title: Product tile
description: A quiet product tile for editorial grids: one link, a picture that swaps on hover, the name and the price, with a skeleton and no buttons.
docs: Prices are minor units with a currency, and locale should always be passed so the price matches on the server and in the browser. The tile holds no button, so it is safe in a carousel; set priority on the first row and pass renderImage to use next/image. ProductTileSkeleton keeps the grid steady while data loads.
